candidate.title: LangChain Function Calling Agents vs. ReACt Agents – What's Right for You?
candidate.description:
Today we dive into the world of LangChain implementation to explore the distinctions and practical uses of Function Calling agents versus ReACt agents. 🤖✨

What will you learn?

Differences Between Agents: Understand the key differences between Function Calling and ReACt agents.

Advantages & Disadvantages: We discuss the pros and cons of each approach to help you decide which is best for your needs.

Responsibility of Tool Selection: Find out who holds the responsibility for tool selection and why it matters in your software development process.
Vendor Support & Implementation: Learn how different vendors like OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic support these functionalities and how LangChain provides a seamless interface for them.
